summary: 在海上突发险情、事故及各类应急事件时，无人机可快速响应、第一时间飞抵事发海域，实时回传现场全景画面与态势信息，实现高效辅助决策与远程调度。同时可开展目标搜寻、人员定位，并搭载应急投放装置，精准投递救生物资。
summary_en: In case of maritime emergencies, accidents, and various incidents, UAVs can respond quickly and fly to the scene immediately, providing real-time panoramic views and situational information for efficient auxiliary decision-making and remote dispatch. They also conduct target searching and personnel positioning, and can be equipped with emergency delivery devices to accurately drop life-saving supplies.
key_application: 海上搜救、物资投送、应急响应
key_application_en: Maritime SAR, Material delivery, Emergency response
key_parameter_1: 响应速度: 第一时间到达现场
key_parameter_1_en: Response speed: Arrive at the scene immediately
key_parameter_2: 载酬能力: 挂载救生圈/应急包/通信基站
key_parameter_2_en: Payload capability: Mount lifebuoys/emergency kits/comm base stations

parameters_en.Search Tech: IR thermal imaging for personnel positioning

detail_html:
方案深度解析

海边突发险情时，传统救援船只到达速度受限。无人机可无视地形障碍，第一时间送达救生物资，为生命争取时间。

  • 实时回传全景态势
  • 高清光电红外全方位搜寻
  • 精准投递救生物资
detail_html_en:
Solution Deep Dive

Traditional rescue vessels are limited by speed during coastal emergencies. UAVs can bypass terrain obstacles and deliver life-saving supplies immediately to buy time for survival.

  • Real-time situational feedback
  • HD EO/IR all-round searching
  • Precision delivery of rescue materials
